scan.pinterest_status: Pinterest's official Newsroom, Business and Creator surfaces, Pinterest Predicts, the 2026 Palette, the current content calendar and relevant public Pinterest inspiration were checked on 30 October 2026. The newest durable visual-production signal is Pinterest Restyle's reference-led room editing: upload a real space, compare distinct style edits, then add or swap decor while retaining the user's room as the decision context. Current seasonal beauty, tactile craft, colour and full-funnel signals remain covered by existing systems.
scan.chatgpt_status: Production v2.26.0 with 721 commands was read before editing. Generic scene edits, reference locks and taste mapping exist, but no command owns spatial restyling with architecture, camera, perspective, scale and non-target preservation plus like-for-like style comparison and focused add/remove/swap passes. Added /spatial-restyle-system without changing the 721 existing commands, 40 bundles, settings or personal creative intelligence. Candidate v2.27.0 passed all 22 regression checks.
trends: Reference-led spatial restyling is moving from generic inspiration toward in-context comparison inside the user’s actual room
Useful room edits separate immutable architecture and camera evidence from editable finishes, furniture, lighting and decor layers
Comparable style territories are more actionable when they preserve the same viewpoint, shell and spatial proportions
Focused add or swap passes can extend a selected direction without regenerating unrelated room details
Pinterest continues to favor personal remixing over literal copying, supported by taste, beauty and colour guidance
Seasonal beauty, tactile hobbies, Neo Deco, colour-led discovery and intent-to-action creative remain active but already covered

commands_added.name: /spatial-restyle-system
commands_added.detail: Creates three like-for-like room or set restyle territories, locks architecture/camera/scale, separates editable layers, and finishes with a focused edit brief plus preservation and safety QA.

skipped: No Barbie-specific or named-style alias because /spatial-restyle-system is a brand-neutral reusable workflow
No separate room moodboard command because /taste-discovery-system and /moodboard already cover pre-edit taste exploration
No generic background-edit alias because /same-shot-edit, /background-only and /images-25-edit-focus already cover narrow edits; the new value is spatial evidence and controlled comparison
No Copper Hair, Vamp Romantic, Glamoratti, Neo Deco or Palette-colour aliases because existing beauty, trend, material and colour systems already cover them
No Q5 or BFCM alias because /intent-to-action, /performance-creative-mix, /catalog-creative-system and /content-lifecycle-system already cover the durable creative transitions
Public Pinterest graphic-design Pins repeated established 2026 trend summaries and did not justify additional style commands
